list.title: Accounts
list.subtitle: Where your money is, and what you owe on your cards.

empty.activeBody: Create your first account to start recording transactions.
empty.inactiveBody: When you deactivate an account it will show up here so you can still look it up.

deactivate.question: Deactivate “{{name}}”? You will not be able to record new transactions in it; you can still look it up.

form.createSubtitle: Give it a name you recognize, pick its currency, and say how much money it starts with.
form.editSubtitle: The currency can only change while the account has no transactions.
form.readOnly: This account is deactivated: you can look it up, but you cannot edit it or record new transactions in it.
form.readOnlyCurrency: This account uses a currency that is no longer supported: you can look it up, but you cannot edit it or record new transactions in it.
form.identityLocked: This account already has transactions: its name, currency and type can no longer change.
form.balanceHint: It can be negative if the account is overdrawn. Up to {{decimals}} decimals.
form.balanceRequired: Enter the opening balance; use 0 if the account starts empty.
form.balanceInvalid: Enter a number with up to {{decimals}} decimals.
form.balanceTooLarge: The balance cannot have more than {{digits}} whole digits.
form.openingHint: When the account started; it cannot be later than now.
form.kindLocked: The type can no longer change: the account has transactions.

card.createSubtitle: A card with a credit limit, a statement day and a payment day.
card.debtHint: What you owe today, according to your bank. That way you don't have to record old purchases.
card.debtNegative: Enter the debt as a positive number; use 0 if the card has no debt.
card.limitHint: With the limit we can show you how much credit you have left.
card.paysNextMonth: The payment falls in the month after the statement because the payment day is not after the statement day.
card.paysSameMonth: The payment falls in the same month as the statement.
card.shortMonths: If a month has fewer days, we use its last day.
card.daysChangeNote: Changing the statement or payment day only affects new purchases. Installments already recorded stay in their months.

errors.ACCOUNT_NAME_REQUIRED: Enter a name for the account.
errors.ACCOUNT_NAME_MAX_LENGTH: The name can be up to {{nameMax}} characters.
errors.ACCOUNT_NAME_LOCKED: The account already has transactions, so its name cannot change.
errors.ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: We could not find this account.
errors.ACCOUNT_CURRENCY_INVALID: That currency is not available. Pick one from the list.
errors.ACCOUNT_CURRENCY_LOCKED: The account already has transactions, so its currency cannot change.
errors.ACCOUNT_OPENING_DATE_REQUIRED: Enter the day and time you opened the account.
errors.ACCOUNT_OPENING_DATE_FUTURE: The opening date cannot be later than now.
errors.ACCOUNT_LOCKED_BY_CLOSED_PERIOD: You can't change the opening balance or currency: there are closed months since this account opened. Reopen them first.
errors.ACCOUNT_KIND_INVALID: Choose whether it is a regular account or a credit card.
errors.ACCOUNT_KIND_LOCKED: The account already has transactions, so its type can't change.
errors.ACCOUNT_STATEMENT_DAY_INVALID: The statement day must be between 1 and 31.
errors.ACCOUNT_PAYMENT_DAY_INVALID: The payment day must be between 1 and 31.
errors.ACCOUNT_CREDIT_LIMIT_INVALID: The credit limit must be greater than 0. Leave it empty if you don't know it.
errors.CREDIT_CARD_INITIAL_BALANCE_POSITIVE: A card's debt can't start as a credit balance. Enter it as a positive number.
errors.ACCOUNT_NOT_CREDIT_CARD: This account is not a credit card.

statement.notFoundBody: We couldn't find this card, or the account is not a credit card.
statement.title: {{name}} statement
statement.openNote: This statement hasn't closed yet: purchases you make through {{cut}} are added here.
statement.upcomingNote: This statement hasn't started yet: its cycle begins {{start}}. It shows installments already scheduled; you pay them after it closes, by {{due}}.
statement.openingDebtHint: The debt the card had when you added it.
statement.transferNote: Paying the card is a transfer from your bank. It doesn't count as spending: each installment already counts in its month's budget.
